description: Look up the Medicare negotiated Maximum Fair Price (MFP) for a drug selected under the Inflation Reduction Act drug price negotiation program, by brand name (Enbrel, Farxiga, Ofev), generic or active ingredient (etanercept, dapagliflozin) or NDC. Returns the price per 30-day equivalent supply for each year 2026-2028 (in effect, ended by deselection, not yet effective, or selected with the price not yet published), with the CMS source and data_as_of. A drug that is not on any selected list returns selected:false with an explicit statement, never a zero price.

drug.description: Brand name, generic/active ingredient, or NDC (e.g. "Enbrel", "dapagliflozin", "00003-0893")

year.description: Optional single year to return (2026, 2027 or 2028). Default: all three.

name: mfp_lookup
title: Mfp Lookup
